description: This file is the __init__.py for the torch._inductor package, defining functions and imports related to TorchInductor's compilation, packaging, and execution features.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compile a given FX graph with TorchInductor, allowing capturing FX graphs without TorchDynamo.

methods.name: aoti_compile_and_package
methods.description: Compile an exported program with AOTInductor and package into a .pt2 artifact.

methods.name: _aoti_compile_and_package_inner
methods.description: Internal function to compile and optionally run or check accuracy of a model.

methods.name: aoti_load_package
methods.description: Load a model from a PT2 package, with options for threading and device.

methods.name: aot_compile
methods.description: Ahead-of-time compile a FX graph into a shared library or package.

methods.name: list_mode_options
methods.description: Return available optimization modes and their options.

methods.name: list_options
methods.description: List available configuration options for torch._inductor.

methods.name: cudagraph_mark_step_begin
methods.description: Indicate start of a new inference/training iteration for CUDA graphs.

methods.name: standalone_compile
methods.description: Precompile a FX graph module into a CompiledArtifact for later use.
